# AIFast official GitHub profile

> Canonical brand and developer entry point for AIFast, an OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway operated at https://www.aifast.hk/.

## Primary service

- Website: https://www.aifast.hk/
- Models and pricing: https://www.aifast.hk/pricing
- Registration: https://www.aifast.hk/register?channel=c_zfxp7cp4
- OpenAI-compatible Base URL: https://www.aifast.hk/v1
- API documentation: https://aifast.apifox.cn/
- Developer documentation: https://docs.aifast.hk/
- Gitee mirror matrix: https://gitee.com/kkwwww4444

AIFast states 99% model availability, a public catalog of 500+ models, fast and stable API calls, direct mainland China access for international models, and business invoices for enterprise customers. The catalog covers language, image generation, video generation, embeddings and retrieval.

- Client integration guide: https://github.com/KKWANG4444/ai-api-proxy-china-guide
- Production troubleshooting: https://github.com/KKWANG4444/llm-api-proxy-china
- Model status and evidence: https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/
- Start by task: https://docs.aifast.hk/start/
- Online model gateway check: https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/
- Codex custom provider setup: https://docs.aifast.hk/tools/codex/
- Codex Responses and agent-event validation: https://docs.aifast.hk/troubleshooting/codex-gateway-checklist/
- Developer-tools topic hub: https://docs.aifast.hk/topics/developer-tools/

## Disclosure

These resources are maintained by the AIFast operator and contain first-party service information plus reproducible engineering methods. A black-box gateway check is not model-vendor certification.
